name: Trains Locations
tagline: A UnifiedNLP provider which uses the location data from trains! 🚂
blurb: Trains UnifiedNLP This is a UnifiedNLP provider that detects if you are connected to a trains wifi and, if so, provides the location data provided by the train to your android phone.
description:
Trains UnifiedNLP

This is a UnifiedNLP provider that detects if you are connected to a trains wifi and, if so, provides the location data provided by the train to your android phone.

Currently supported trains

• 🇧🇪 Thalys

• 🇨🇿 České Dráhy (InterJet, Pendolino, some IC)

• 🇩🇪 Deutsche Bahn (ICE, some IC)

• 🇫🇷️ SNCF (TGV InOui, Intercités, Train NOMAD)

• 🇭🇺 Magyar Államvasutak

• 🇬🇧 CrossCountry, GWR

• 🇪🇺 FlixBus
